what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Brazil in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 66672 asylum seekers from Brazil.
The United States hosts the largest share, 81.8%, followed by Mexico, Italy and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Brazil, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 649 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 86150, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Brazil are counted separately.
